nodes.role: Epistemic envelope, claim classification, provenance/falsification gates
Structural graph of traditions, canons, books, passages, manuscripts, chronology and source roots
Associative semantic expansion: motifs, symbols, possible parallels, alternate readings
Bind structural and associative packets, collapse derivative sources to roots, preserve disagreement
Scout decomposition and independent task packets across traditions and source families
Freeze authority boundary, protocol identity, receipts and supersession lineage
Construct falsifiers, claim ceilings, negative-result preservation and conventional alternatives
Adversarial/blinded review of proposed textual parallels; search for mundane and translation explanations
Canonicalization, witness/source lifecycle, append-only evidence state and fail-closed validation
Anti-pseudoreplication: distinguish independent textual witnesses from copied/derivative families; blind gates
Parallel task packets; keep model identities and source dependencies separate
Append-only artifact lineage, hashes, corrections, supersession and cross-repository references
Reverse-direction search: start from a motif/result and walk backward to earliest attestations and alternate causes
Freeze stable candidate invariants only after they survive provenance and falsification gates
Symbolic or intuitive association generator to widen search space
Narrative rendering after evidence state is frozen; must preserve uncertainty labels

pipeline.action: Freeze exact claim before searching for confirming parallels
Map tradition-specific canon and category; never assume all traditions mean scripture the same way
Resolve original-language witness, manuscript/edition, translation, source root, date and geography
Generate semantic motif candidates without promotion
For each candidate, walk backward to earliest known attestations and known contact routes
Attack each match using translation convergence, generic human universals, genre convention, interpolation, shared intermediary and cherry-picking explanations
Compare against unrelated control texts and shuffled passage windows to estimate false-match rate
Collapse copied traditions/editions to historical source families before counting recurrence
Classify result as textual dependence, probable diffusion, generic convergence, unresolved, refuted or insufficient data
Re-enter earlier stages with discovered constraints; preserve prior failed paths instead of rewriting them

candidate_hypotheses.claim: Apparent similarities arise from common human cognitive, ecological, social or literary constraints
A motif or passage moved through identifiable contact, translation or literary dependence
Two or more witnesses descend from a shared earlier textual/oral source
A rare structured motif independently emerged in separated traditions
Similarities prove a single supernatural source or revelation
